title: Assistant Electrical Engineer (Construction) Ireland
description: At Natural Power, we have been pioneers of positive renewable change for 30 years. If you’re looking for a job in the renewable energy industry, we could be just the place to advance your career. As we continue to grow, we are now seeking to strengthen our Construction team with a **Assistant Electrical Engineer** at our **Castlebar or Dublin Location** . We operate in a variety of geographies including Ireland, the UK, France, Italy, Germany, wider Europe, the Nordic countries and North America, with aspirations to grow and expand our international markets and to develop our services to encompass the broadest range of renewable and low carbon technologies. The Irish Construction Project Management Team comprises a professional and passionate group of engineers and construction management professionals supporting our clients to deliver their renewable energy projects on time, within budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. We operate in a cooperative, supportive and open manner and support all staff in developing to their full potential. Our team provide technical advisory, site supervision and project management services to make sure that projects are planned and constructed in line with necessary requirements. The successful applicant will: assist in providing electrical engineering services on a consultancy basis supporting client requirements to achieve the objectives of individual renewables projects; support the Senior Electrical Engineer in managing electrical technical interfaces; and grow, develop and consolidate Natural Power’s pre-construction and construction phase service provision. Projects include onshore wind, solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), hydro, renewable heat and a variety of other associated evolving technologies. While specific experience working in the renewables sector is not a pre-requisite it is a very desirable attribute for applicants to the role. Similarly experience of transmission connections, is of particular benefit. **Why Join Us?** This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career electrical engineer to develop their expertise in renewable energy, grid infrastructure and construction delivery. Supported by experienced engineers and project managers, you will work on a diverse portfolio of onshore wind, solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS) and grid connection projects across Ireland and Europe. The successful candidate will gain exposure to the development, design, construction and commissioning phases of renewable energy projects while benefiting from a structured development pathway towards Electrical Engineer and Chartered Engineer status. **Main Tasks and Responsibilities** The main purpose of the role is to assist the electrical engineering and projects team providing successful pre-construction and construction phase consultancy services by supporting electrical engineers and project managers to deliver client and contract requirements. Typical (non-exhaustive) tasks and responsibilities include: * Provide electrical engineering advice and grid consultancy services to clients regarding costs, timelines and technical aspects of grid connections and renewable generation technology * Preparation and submission of grid connection applications and modifications for renewable projects * Ensure technical aspects and electrical infrastructure associated with wind farms, solar PV plants and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects are designed, installed and commissioned in accordance with employer’s requirements and contractor’s specifications * Ensure contestable grid connection infrastructure is designed, installed and commissioned in accordance with system operator functional specifications. * Assist in the coordination of design reviews with DSO’s, TSO’s and other grid authorities. * Provide technical support to Project Manager / Owner’s Engineer to assist with project delivery. * Assist with the preparation of technical specifications and employer’s requirements for solar, BESS, turbine supply, electrical balance of plant and contestable grid connection work packages. * Review technical aspects of electrical infrastructure via documentation and on site to ensure that risks to operation, compliance and operational lifetime are identified and mitigated. * Attend site meetings and undertake site visits to inspect electrical works and prepare snagging lists. * Support grid code compliance testing processes. * Work with the Natural Power Advisory team to provide technical due diligence advisory services to renewable energy developers, asset owners and investors. * Keep abreast of grid connection and renewable energy policy and technology developments. * Assist with the management of designers and specialist subconsultants where required. This is a **PERMANENT, FULL-TIME** role, working **37.5** hours per week, **Monday to Friday - Hybrid - 3 days onsite or in the office and 2 days WFH.** We will offer an engaging, collaborative and fast-paced environment alongside an excellent benefits package, including generous annual leave, flexible working, employee assistance programme, personal insurances, health plans, discounts and salary sacrifice options. Natural Power is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. You can find the full role profile for this vacancy attached below. Details of all our currently available opportunities can be found on our website. Natural Power reserves the right to remove this vacancy at any time.

We rely on our Equity Research analysts to be on the front lines of market information to translate it into trading ideas. As an Equity Research intern, you will be responsible for finding opportunities that other market participants may not be capitalizing on, either by discovering new information or considering existing knowledge from a different perspective. You will be embedded in our buy-side strategy-focused trading desk monitoring your own basket of stocks ranging across various sectors such as Macro, Index, ETF, Equity and more. Whether it’s interpreting an intraday headline, conveying opinions around the dynamics of a sector, or prepping in advance for a future event, you will work collaboratively with Traders who rely heavily on the analysis you provide to make trading decisions. **What We Offer** * Education: Susquehanna’s in-house education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. You will attend regular seminars to learn about options and the decision-making strategies that our traders employ. You will also be assigned a mentor from the Equity Research team to guide you along the way. * Real Impact: You will work collaboratively with research analysts and traders on your desk to develop trade ideas on your allocated basket of stocks and provide real-time opinions on breaking news throughout the trading day. * Culture: Our non-hierarchical culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. * Perks: Based in the heart of Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, and a 10-minute walk from Dublin’s city centre, our employees avail of free onsite catering, a games room, and a large in house gym, to name but a few of our favourite perks. You will have the opportunity to attend multiple social events hosted by Susquehanna. **What We're Looking For** * Market Enthusiast: Keeping up to date on current events and breaking news that affect the markets is something you naturally enjoy. From company/sector specific news to macro stories, you are up to date on recent headlines. * Collaborator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas and expressing your thoughts based on your own research whilst combining the expert’s opinion to come to the best trading decisions. * Numerical & Logical: When it comes to decision making, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data from historic events to come up with current trade ideas. * Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics or another passion you have, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. * Curious: You’re eager to find out more about what it’s like to work in the Finance sector, and specifically Equity Research. Have a passion and identifiable interest in the financial markets and current affairs. * Class of 2027 or 2028: Successful interns are invited back as graduates to join our Equity Research Analyst Graduate Programme. Depending on when you graduate, you will be invited to join our graduate programme in either January or August 2028. **About Susquehanna** Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. **Interview Process** Apply > Quantitative & Finance Assessment > Recruiter Interview > Interview > Final round interview > Offer Our Summer Internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. If you would like to read what our Equity Research Analysts say about working in Susquehanna, check out the Meet Our Team page on our website: https://sig.com/about/team/ **Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Ireland.** \*\*Final tip - We hire for this internship on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.\*\* **Please note that applications for this job require an online assessment. This assessment is administered by a third party company, Induslynk Training Services Private Limited (doing business as Mercer | Mettl), registered in India. By clicking through to apply for this job you are giving Susquehanna your consent to have your email address transferred to Mercer | Mettl by the administrator of our careers platform. Mercer | Mettl will then contact you directly in order to administer the assessment. The results of your assessment will be shared with Susquehanna for the purposes set out and in accordance with Susquehanna’s Privacy Policy:** **https://sig.com/about/privacy-policy/** **. Mercer |Mettl’s Privacy Policy can be found here:** **https://mettl.com/en/privacy-policy/** **.** **Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us.** *If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.*

title: Expression of Interest - Power Transmission & Distribution Professionals (Design) - Dublin
description: Our multi-disciplinary team of Power industry specialists partners with some of the most recognised brands in the power sector, delivering innovative and sustainable design solutions to complex challenges. By combining technical expertise with a client-first philosophy, we help shape the future of an industry that is constantly evolving. Our open and honest approach, alongside our reputation for getting things right the first time, has enabled us to build long-standing partnerships with clients who trust us to deliver exceptional outcomes. As part of our continued growth in Ireland, we are expanding our Dublin presence and strengthening our Power capability. This marks an exciting step in our journey and presents an opportunity to build a strong local team that will play a key role in establishing and growing our capability in the Irish market. **Our Plan** We are keen to connect with engineering professionals interested in joining a growing, forward-looking team delivering critical energy infrastructure across Ireland. **We Would Particularly Welcome Conversations With Professionals Experienced In** * Substation design and delivery (HV) * Underground cable (HV) design and project delivery (transmission & distribution) * Power Transmission & Distribution Infrastructure Design Management * Civil and Structural Design Engineering within Power Transmission and Distribution industry We have medium to long-term growth plans for our Dublin operation. The right role for you may not exist today, however, we are building capability strategically and would welcome the opportunity to start conversations ahead of future live requirements. This is a genuine opportunity to be part of building and shaping a capability from the ground up - helping determine how it evolves, how teams are structured, how projects are delivered, and how we position ourselves in the Irish power market over the long term. Whether you are an experienced specialist, an established project leader or earlier in your career looking to grow within the power sector, we would love to hear from you. **What’s in it for you?** * Help build something new - Be part of growing and shaping our Dublin power infrastructure capability - not just delivering projects but defining how we operate long term. * Backed by the UK’s top Power team - Leverage the expertise, reputation and support of our established UK power specialists while helping expand our Irish footprint. * Work on critical infrastructure - Contribute to major substation and underground cable projects supporting Ireland’s energy future. * Influence and visibility - Join at a stage where your ideas and expertise will directly shape our growth. * Real progression potential - As capability expands, so will leadership and specialist opportunities. If you are passionate about power infrastructure and open to exploring future opportunities, we encourage you to express your interest. *This role is being advertised as an Expression of Interest as we begin building our presence in Dublin. We’re keen to connect with talented individuals who are excited by the opportunity to help shape and grow our future team in the region. By expressing your interest, you’ll be part of the early conversations as we identify and prepare for upcoming opportunities, and start establishing our capability in the Irish market.*

title: Finance Business Partner
description: ***On behalf of a growing Renewables firm in Dublin, we are looking to hire a Finance Business Partner.*** Our client is looking to hire a commercially minded, recently qualified accountant who enjoys working alongside project teams and wants to play a real part in Ireland's energy transition. You will sit close to the business and partner with project, development and leadership teams across a portfolio of large-scale renewable and infrastructure projects. The role combines financial control with commercial decision support and suits someone who is comfortable asking the hard questions. **Responsibilities:** * Partner with project managers and senior stakeholders to challenge budgets, forecasts, cost profiles and business cases * Provide scenario analysis and financial insight to support investment and project decisions * Prepare and review monthly management accounts and commentary, and support year-end and audit * Own cashflow forecasting, cost tracking and controls across multiple project entities * Support tax compliance, structuring and accounting treatment for development and operational assets * Help build and scale finance processes as the portfolio grows **What You'll Bring:** * ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified with 0-2 years PQE (Big 4 trained desirable) * Experience in a capital-intensive or project-based sector such as energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction or property * Solid grounding in management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis * Good technical accounting knowledge and tax awareness * The confidence to influence and challenge non-finance colleagues * Exposure to renewables, regulated infrastructure or multi-entity structures is a plus, but not essential This is an excellent opportunity for a recently qualified accountant to enter a commerccial, business partnering role with visibility to senior leadership, and a clear platform to grow your career within a business that is scaling in one of Ireland's most important sectors. For a confidential conversation, contact Conor Dignam at cdignam@alliedtalent.ie or apply directly.

title: Geospatial Graduate Consultant - Dublin
description: See it differently You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity At Arup, our Geospatial team combines geospatial data, remote sensing, digital innovation and analytical expertise to help solve some of the world's most complex challenges across the built and natural environment. As part of our Consulting and Digital Services business, you will work on impactful projects that support sustainable infrastructure, climate resilience, nature restoration, transport network and digital transformation initiatives. Working alongside specialists from multiple disciplines, you will use cutting-edge geospatial technologies to capture, analyse, model and visualise data, helping clients make informed decisions that create positive outcomes for people and the planet. As a Graduate Geospatial Consultant, you will contribute (but not be limited) to: * Support the delivery of geospatial and digital projects to agreed quality, budget and programme requirements. * Apply GIS, remote sensing and spatial data analysis techniques to solve real-world client challenges. * Process, analyse and visualise geospatial datasets using industry-leading tools and technologies. * Contribute to the design, testing and implementation of geospatial data systems and digital solutions. * Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to integrate geospatial insights into wider engineering, planning and environmental projects. * Develop your technical skills in geospatial technologies, data management, automation and emerging digital solutions. Is this role right for you? For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: A Bachelor's degree (Level 8 or above), Master's degree or PhD in a relevant discipline, including: * Geographic Information Systems (GIS) & Remote Sensing * Geospatial Data Analysis * Geographic Information Science (GIScience) * Geo-Information Science & Earth Observation * Geocomputation * Geoinformatics * Geography (with a strong GIS focus) * Environmental Science with Geospatial Applications * Spatial Data Science * Surveying and Geomatics * Earth Observation and Remote Sensing **Desirable Skills & Experience** * Knowledge of ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online and/or QGIS. * Exposure to Python, SQL or other data analysis tools. * Understanding of spatial data management and GIS workflows. * Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving abilities. * Excellent communication and teamwork skills. * Interest in geospatial innovation, digital technologies and sustainability. * Experience with FME, Earth Observation, spatial databases, BIM workflows, GIS application development or open-source GIS tools would be advantageous but is not essential. We also welcome applications from candidates who hold, or are currently pursuing, a Master's degree or PhD in a relevant discipline. Whether your qualification is at Bachelor's, Master's or Doctoral level, we are looking for individuals who demonstrate technical excellence, curiosity, creativity and a passion for shaping a more sustainable built environment. To Be Considered For a Graduate Opportunity, Your Application Must Include a Copy Of Your Academic Transcript And Meet The Following Criteria * No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role * Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts. Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. We advise that you apply early. **Closing Date :** 12 November 2026 **Eligibility** We're able to consider candidates who require an employment permit to work in Ireland, where the role and offered salary meet the Irish Government's eligibility criteria (for example, under the Critical Skills or General Employment Permit schemes). All Employment Permits are granted at the discretion of the Deciding Officer with offers contingent to obtaining the correct immigration to work and reside in Ireland." What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates. For our permanent members we offer private medical insurance allowances, life assurance and income protection cover. Different people, shared values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates may inform us of any disability, learning difference, or other circumstance that may require reasonable adjustments for interviews or assessments. Any information provided will be used only to make appropriate arrangements and will not be considered in any other aspect of your application or selection process. #IRELAND\_GRADS

title: Graduate AI Engineer
description: **Junior AI Engineer** **Job Description** My client, a professional services organisation, is seeking a Junior AI Engineer to join a growing technology and automation function, supporting the development of AI-enabled applications, integrations and intelligent workflow solutions. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test and support internal AI-powered tools and workflow automations that improve business processes and reduce manual activity. * Build and maintain APIs and integrations that enable AI models to interact securely with enterprise applications, data sources and business systems. * Develop production-quality solutions using technologies such as Python and Rust, with exposure to TypeScript and Node.js where appropriate. * Support the development of AI agent workflows, including prompt design, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and appropriate technical safeguards. * Work with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph to develop integrated automation solutions. * Use Git and GitHub for source control, branching, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD processes and general development collaboration. * Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture notes, support documentation, implementation guidance and operational procedures. * Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and refine applications based on user feedback. **Experience Required** * 1-3 years’ professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, automation or a related technical area, with strong graduate, academic, personal or open-source projects also considered. * Practical experience developing solutions using generative AI models and associated APIs rather than solely using consumer chat interfaces. * Good understanding of AI concepts including prompting, context management, function or tool calling and the limitations of large language models. * Working knowledge of Rust, ideally demonstrated through an academic, personal or open-source project, together with an understanding of concepts such as ownership, error handling and dependency management. * Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern Python project, environment and dependency management tools. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs, including working with JSON, authentication mechanisms, error handling and API documentation. * Good understanding of core software engineering practices including testing, debugging, maintainable code and version control. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues from non-technical backgrounds. **Desirable Skills** * Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents or frameworks supporting multi-step tool use and workflow orchestration. * Knowledge of Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph or Microsoft Copilot. * TypeScript and Node.js development experience. * Understanding of SQL, document processing, vector databases, semantic search or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Exposure to Azure services such as Functions, App Service, Key Vault or Storage. * Familiarity with Docker, cloud deployment practices and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience evaluating AI applications, including logging, tracing, output quality measurement, reliability and cost monitoring. * Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, responsible AI and regulatory considerations when developing AI-enabled systems. * Understanding of secure software development practices including secrets management, least-privilege access, prompt-injection risks and prevention of unintended data exposure. * Experience with workflow automation or low-code platforms would be beneficial. **Educational Requirements** * Third-level degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another related discipline. * Candidates with a strong demonstrable portfolio of equivalent technical work may also be considered. **Working Hours & Benefits** * Permanent position with standard Monday-to-Friday working hours. * Opportunity to join a developing AI and automation capability at an early stage. * Broad exposure to AI engineering, software development, APIs, cloud technologies and enterprise automation. * Opportunity to work directly with experienced technology leadership and contribute to engineering standards and ways of working. * Continued professional development in a rapidly evolving area of technology. * Exposure to a range of modern AI models, platforms and development tools. **How to Apply** To apply for this role, please submit your updated CV. If your skills and experience match job requirements, you will be contacted to discuss your application in detail. **Similar Roles Open** As a specialised recruitment agency, we also have several other permanent and contract IT roles available. Visit our website for more information or explore additional opportunities.

title: Graduate Development Programme - Construction
description: **Summary** From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl. With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team. **Training and Development** At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job- it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the **only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland** , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around *you* . **What makes it different?** * Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals. * Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. * Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates- we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? **Construction** The Construction department in our head office is essentially responsible for how our store and warehouse buildings look and feel. The department defines exactly how stores should be built, how they should look and essentially how much they will cost. They handle several store building projects each year and support regional teams who build stores locally. Head Office Construction is also responsible for any new build or major project related to any of our regional distribution centres or our Dublin head office. title: Investment Banking & Investment Management Graduate Programme 2027- 2029
description: 9 Oct 2026 Dublin, IE, IE **Goodbody Investment Banking & Investment Management Graduate Programme** **Start date: September 2027** **About Goodbody** For more than 150 years, Goodbody has helped clients make informed financial decisions and move forward with confidence. Today, we are an intelligence-led capital, investment and wealth platform with global reach, connecting insight, expertise and opportunity to deliver exceptional outcomes for businesses, individuals and institutions. With more than 400 employees across Dublin, London, Cork and Galway, we combine deep expertise with a collaborative culture that enables our people to grow and succeed. Guided by our values and recognised through multiple employer and workplace culture awards, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where ambition is supported, development is encouraged and careers can flourish. **About the Goodbody Graduate Programme** This is an exciting opportunity for graduates looking to develop a career in the financial services industry and to join our high performing teams in our Dublin office on Dawson Street. During this programme, you will have the chance to work alongside and gain experience from our teams of highly qualified professionals who have unrivalled experience within the industry. For the 2027 – 2029 cycle, candidates will choose their preference between: **Investment Banking** – Corporate Advisory, Equity Trading, and Research Investment Banking supports companies as they make important financial and strategic decisions. Within this area, graduates can gain exposure to Corporate Advisory, Equity Trading, Research and Sustainability, while learning how teams analyse businesses and markets, support transactions and communicate insights to clients and investors. This is a great option for graduates who are curious about financial markets, enjoy working with numbers and want to understand how companies raise funding, grow and make strategic decisions. With guidance from experienced colleagues, you could help research companies, industries and market trends; gather and check information for financial analysis; assist with valuations and financial models; and contribute to presentations and materials used in client meetings or live transactions. Depending on your rotation, you may also learn how equity markets operate, how investment research is developed and how sustainability considerations inform business and investment decisions. Throughout the programme, you will build a strong foundation in financial analysis, commercial awareness, teamwork, attention to detail and clear communication. **Investment Management** - Private Equity and Asset Management Investment Management is about researching opportunities and making informed decisions about where and how money is invested, with the aim of delivering long-term returns while managing risk. Within this area, graduates can gain exposure to Asset Management and Private Equity (Capital Partners), learning how investment professionals assess markets, companies and different types of investments. This is a strong option for graduates who are interested in financial markets, enjoy analysing information and want to understand what makes an investment attractive. You may support company and market research, review financial statements, build financial models, monitor existing investments and help prepare investment recommendations and presentations. You could also gain an understanding of public markets and wider economic trends, as well as how private equity teams assess and support growing businesses. Throughout the programme, you will develop your analytical thinking, commercial awareness, attention to detail and ability to communicate clear investment insights while working alongside experienced colleagues. Graduates will choose their preferred business area and have the opportunity to rotate and work on various teams within the business area. From day one, you will be a valued member of our team and will have the opportunity to work with team members of all levels, supporting them in delivering successful outcomes for our clients. You will be provided with support across the programme including a dedicated buddy, educational support, as well as training in core competencies along with regular feedback and networking opportunities. **About you: Requirements for the Graduate Programme** * Curiosity: Open mindset and genuine interest in how the firm operates, exploring new ideas and asking thoughtful questions. * Client focused: Professional Approach and presence * Passion for financial services: Aptitude and interest in financial services * Good Communication: Written, verbal and interpersonal communication is key * Energetic and Enthusiastic: A positive presence in the office and in the programme * Team player: Commitment to collaboration and teamwork * Project Management: Ability to work on time sensitive projects and prioritise tasks * Focused and Driven: A self-starter focused on achieving goals * Strong academics: Third level qualification with honours degree Applications are expected to close on the **25th** **October 2026** however, we encourage candidates to apply early as the programme may close sooner if demand is high. Candidates must be fully authorised to work in Ireland or hold a valid work permit for the full duration of the programme (23 months commencing September 2027). Goodbody is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace which values and benefits from the diversity of our workforce. Please read the Goodbody Recruitment Privacy Notice. By submitting your personal data to us, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Notice and agree to the use of your personal data in line with this. We will only use the information that we collect about you lawfully in accordance with the Data Protection Acts, 1988 and 2003 and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Goodbody Stockbrokers UC, trading as Goodbody, is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. In the UK, Goodbody is also subject to regulation by the Financial Conduct Authority. Goodbody is a member of Euronext Dublin and the London Stock Exchange. Goodbody is a member of the group of companies headed by AIB Group plc. **Job Segment:** Bank, Banking, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Market Research, Finance, Marketing

title: Recruitment of Chair of Governing Body - Technological University Dublin
description: The Organisation Since its establishment as Ireland's first Technological University in 2019, TU Dublin has built on its proud heritage of providing accessible pathways to higher education, high-quality careers, as well as advancing internationally recognised research and innovation with significant regional and global impact. We are a vibrant community of 27,000+ students and 3,000+ staff. TU Dublin’s core mission is to provide practice-based and employer-engaged education and research models. A guiding principle is to consolidate TU Dublin’s position as Ireland’s leading university for enterprise talent and innovation across the breadth of our disciplines. TU Dublin holds the highest graduate employability rate among Dublin universities, and TU Dublin is currently the most applied-to University in Ireland. The Role The Governing Body is now seeking to appoint a non-executive Chair of the Governing Body. Through leadership of the Governing Body, the Chair plays a central role in the effective governance and strategic oversight of the University. Key Duties As Chair of the Governing Body, the appointee will: • Provide leadership to the Governing Body, ensuring it is a driving force of the University’s strategy and long-term success, and that it upholds the highest standards of governance. • Ensure that the Governing Body clearly addresses its functions and delivers on its governance responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of legislation and relevant codes of governance, particularly the TU Act 2018 and the HEA Act 2022, and respecting the distinct roles and responsibilities of the Governing Body, President and Academic Council. Key Responsibilities The Chair of the Governing Body will ensure compliance with the requirements of the TU Act 2018 and other relevant legislation in relation to meetings and responsibilities of the Governing Body, such as: • Chairing meetings of Governing Body, holding at least six meetings in every 12-month period and convening additional meetings of the Governing Body as may be deemed necessary. • Assisting in maintaining solid and productive relationships with the University’s key national stakeholders including the Department of Further and Higher Education, Research Innovation and Science (DFHERIS) and the Higher Education Authority. • Ensuring the University meets its financial and other reporting requirements in a full and timely manner, that financial forecasting is performed to a high professional standard, and that the University’s financial and allied functions are appropriately resourced and highly functioning. • Acting as an ambassador and advocate for TU Dublin’s vision and values, forging connections with community, business and government/public stakeholders. • Promoting effective and efficient operation of the Governing Body enabling collective engagement and confidence in the conduct of the business of the Governing Body. • Working with the TU Dublin President and University Executive to ensure the Governing Body has the information, context and reports needed to discharge its responsibilities. • Representing the Governing Body and the University at relevant events and engagements. • Ensuring that the Governing Body's Committees are effectively populated with members with the appropriate competencies and experience, aligned to the remit of each Committee. • Promoting a culture of openness and transparency at the Governing Body meetings, encouraging members to debate constructively and challenge rigorously and respectfully. T he Person The successful individual will have proven experience as a Chair, including leading strategic board and committee meetings. They will bring strong leadership experience in complex and challenging environments, interpersonal skills, a collaborative approach, and sound commercial and financial acumen. A knowledge of the higher education landscape in Ireland is expected, together with a commitment to TU Dublin's culture, vision and values. They will also have a proven track record of championing inclusion, equality and diversity. Essential 1. Experience of chairing high-level, strategic, board and committee meetings and of bringing complex and sensitive matters to a satisfactory conclusion. 2. Leadership experience and expertise, at a senior level, in a large, diverse and complex organisation. 3. Strong interpersonal skills, with an ability to establish a constructive working relationship with Governing Body members, the President and the Executive, and key external stakeholders such as the Higher Education Authority. 4. Demonstrable commercial & financial acumen, governance, risk management and strategic planning and leadership experience. 5. Demonstrable ability to champion inclusion, equality and diversity. 6.
